RBM support to Georgian Foundation for Strategic and International Studies

description.narrative: Sida ger kärnstöd till Georgian Foundation for Strategic and International Studies (nedan kallat GFSIS). Stödet omfattar perioden 1 januari 2022 till 31 december 2024 och en total budget om 22 000 000 SEK. Som en del av beredningen identifierades behov att bidra ytterligare till organisationens institutionella hållbarhet, genom att stödja organisationens utveckling av en strategisk plan och en resursmobiliseringsplan, inklusive utveckla programmets interventionslogik och resultatramverk, genom att avropa expertstöd från Sidas ramavtal för resultatstyrning.

Sida give core support to the Georgian Foundation for Strategic and International Studies (hereinafter referred to as GFSIS). The support covers the period 1 January 2022 to 31 December 2024 and a total budget of SEK 22,000,000. As part of the appraisal, a need was identified to further contribute to the organization's institutional sustainability, by supporting the organization's development of a strategic plan and a resource mobilization plan, including developing the program's intervention logic and results framework, by calling of expert support from Sida's framework agreement for results-based management.
